TestCases.InputPrompt: Can I attach a photo to a ping, and how do people open it?
TestCases.Response: Yes, you can attach a photo to a ping message. When creating a new ping, click the camera icon in the top right corner to add images from your device's gallery or capture photos instantly. Recipients receive the photo as a secure link to the Crises Control cloud, ensuring compliance with GDPR by protecting personal data. They can open the photo by clicking the link in the ping message, which takes them to the secure space to view the image.
TestCases.Reference: FACTS: When creating a ping, a user can attach photos by clicking the 'upload' button in the 'message' section. Recepients of that ping can view the attachments via the portal or click the download link in the email sent to them.
